name: FlyConvert
label: Screen 9 flight meta-search platforms at once to find the cheapest fare. Paste any flight link to instantly verify if it's truly the lowest price.

name: Schengen Calculator
label: Calculate your Schengen 90/180-day visa-free stay. Track stays, check remaining days, plan a future entry, and find your latest exit date — everything is stored locally — nothing is sent to a server.

name: Where2Live
label: Find your next base: digital nomad cities compared equally on monthly Airbnb rent and Numbeo Safety Index, with neighborhood guides and essential services.

name: World Food Map
label: Tap a country to see what people cook there. Local names, photos, and a short note on dishes from 200+ countries.

name: Bon Voyage!
label: Plot stops on a map and choose how you travel between them. Search, drag to reorder, and share the route as a link.

name: Kooda
label: Free Korean lessons for the language people actually speak. Hangul, K-drama phrases, and everyday conversation. 240 lessons, no account needed.

name: Space Sweeper: Survivors
label: Sweep alien swarms, evolve sci-fi weapons and survive your 12-minute shift.

name: Solace Isle
label: A cozy island life with three cats. Build a home, decorate, fish the quiet pond, and live slowly.

name: InfinitePuppy
label: Explore an infinite world of adorable puppies and discover pure joy in every scroll.

name: EditNow
label: EditNow is a free, browser-based canvas editor. No sign-up or uploads required. Everything stays in your browser and saves automatically. Add images, text, shapes, and drawings, then export or copy your work as a PNG.

name: Cinder Paper
label: A notebook with no memory. Write everything down, then watch it burn to ash. Nothing is saved, nothing follows you.

name: The Quiet Observer
label: A sanctuary for deep philosophical thoughts, essays on life, and quiet observations in a fast-paced world.
